rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the feeling of disappointment when reality falls short of expectations.

example.english: I felt real disillusionment after finding out he had lied to me.
example.traditional: 知道佢呃人之後，我真係好失望。
example.jyutping: zi1 dou3 keoi5 ngaak1 jan4 zi1 hau6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 sat1 mong6

rows.note: Use this when a cherished illusion, ideal, or belief collapses, including the resulting state of being disillusioned.

example.english: The scandal caused disillusionment with that idealism.
example.traditional: 呢次醜聞令佢對嗰套理想主義產生幻滅。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 cau2 man4 ling6 keoi5 deoi3 go2 tou3 lei5 soeng2 zyu2 ji6 caan2 saang1 waan6 mit6
